name: Vera
source: Vera, the player character, would keep a rose in her mouth, if that didn't making sweet-talking women--or simply talking--difficult. She has always wanted to be an adventurer, and doesn't mind long walks on the beach if there's a cute girl at the finish line. She likes to name her spells, but doesn't shout "Forbidden Bind!" or "Dangerous Lips!" in battle. Yet.
